jules_csm: Quick ask for ReefHealth (AU pilot). They need a pre-launch configuration: allowlist two partner egress IPs, increase route qps to 1500 for a 5h demo window, and enable client cert verification. Demo is 2026-04-08 10:00 AEST. cc @omar_sre @nina_net

omar_sre: OK. Please confirm public NAT CIDRs and whether the demo needs region pinning (AU only). Also confirm whether alert suppression is desired for that window.

nina_net: Partner sent IPs: 198.51.100.99/32 and 198.51.100.100/32. They requested AU region pin due to data residency. Also they will upload PEM cert with CN=demo.reefhealth.local.

pat_support: Legal approved demo terms; they want the allowlist window to auto-expire. They asked for rollback criteria: error rate >4% or p95 latency >300ms.

ops_bot: Auto-allowlist rules: max 72h. Example command:
redwoodctl allowlist create --name reef-temp --cidrs 198.51.100.99/32,198.51.100.100/32 --expires 2026-04-08T05:30:00Z --regions ap-southeast-2 --note "ReefHealth demo; auto-revoke"
redwoodctl route update --route reef-demo --qps 1500 --region_pin ap-southeast-2
Allowlist slot AL-10099 reserved.

omar_sre: I'll apply allowlist and canary the mTLS verify change. Also will set alert suppression for CS-4701 with strict rollback triggers.

jules_csm: Thanks. I'll confirm cert upload and share connection details with the customer. Please ping here when live so I can update the enablement notes and renewal signals.

omar_sre: Allowlist applied AL-10099, route override reef-demo qps=1500 region_pin=ap-southeast-2. Canary passed, rolling to prod. Links saved in CS-4701. Auto-revoke scheduled.

jules_csm: Great, leaving a note in the account health doc: onboarding progressing, demo scheduled, renewal probability increased pending demo outcome. Closing loop unless extension needed. :thumbsup:
